polaris: Does an independent input-side C_phi exist for nickelate phase-bus readiness, or does every measurable C_phi collapse to ordinary c-axis coherence and sample quality?
framework: Layered-superconductor interlayer response: separate normal single-particle c-axis conductivity from bilayer phase-transfer susceptibility and even/odd interlayer channel structure.
findings: A defensible independent C_phi is not total c-axis conductivity, not Drude fraction, and not dz2 weight. The surviving object is a residual input-side phase-transfer invariant: the part of low-energy interlayer response that is locked to bilayer odd/even phase structure after conditioning on total c-axis spectral weight, Drude fraction/scattering, oxygen-vacancy/disorder/strain proxies, and dz2 spectral weight. The discriminator is rank discordance: two samples or pressure points with matched W_c, f_D, gamma, vacancy/strain proxies, and dz2 weight but different odd/even interlayer phase-transfer index P_oe should be ordered differently by C_phi than by every simpler baseline. This is experimentally meaningful because La3Ni2O7 already has independent evidence for pressure superconductivity, oxygen-vacancy sensitivity, density-wave evolution, orbital/dz2 involvement, and bilayer/odd-channel theory; therefore a C_phi claim must live only in the residual bilayer phase channel.
weakest_link: The invariant is not yet directly measured in pressurized La3Ni2O7 normal-state optics; it requires combining c-axis/THz optical response or reflectivity-derived spectral functions with structural/orbital/disorder controls and, ideally, an odd/even interlayer channel proxy from Raman/RIXS/neutron or pressure-dependent bilayer modeling.
next_plan: Round 2 should stress-test whether P_oe can be operationally extracted without superconducting output: define minimal observables, identify existing figures/data for reanalysis, and test whether the residual can be annihilated by oxygen/strain/dephasing covariance.
literature_needed: La3Ni2O7 pressure optical conductivity; c-axis infrared/THz under pressure; bilayer nickelate odd even spin susceptibility; Raman density wave La3Ni2O7; XANES dz2 pz orbital La3Ni2O7; oxygen vacancies La3Ni2O7 Nature 2024; interlayer Josephson tunneling c-axis optical sum rule

core_discriminator.name: Residual odd-even phase-transfer rank discordance
core_discriminator.definition: C_phi_ind = residual(P_oe | W_c, f_D, gamma, V_O, epsilon_strain, Z_dz2)
core_discriminator.rank_test: If samples i and j satisfy abs(W_c_i-W_c_j), abs(f_D_i-f_D_j), abs(gamma_i-gamma_j), abs(V_O_i-V_O_j), abs(epsilon_i-epsilon_j), and abs(Z_dz2_i-Z_dz2_j) within experimental tolerance, but P_oe_i > P_oe_j, then independent C_phi predicts i ranks above j. Baseline collapse predicts no stable rank difference once the conditioning variables are matched.

opposite_predictions.independent_C_phi: Residual P_oe remains significant and gives a reproducible pre-output rank ordering across matched samples or pressure points.
opposite_predictions.baseline_collapse: Residual P_oe is statistically zero or unstable after conditioning; any apparent rank is absorbed by W_c, f_D, gamma, oxygen/disorder/strain, or dz2 spectral weight.

why_it_avoids_requested_baselines: Total c-axis spectral weight W_c is conditioned out.
Drude fraction f_D and scattering gamma are conditioned out separately, so C_phi is not Drude coherence alone.
Oxygen vacancies, disorder, and strain enter as explicit nuisance controls V_O and epsilon_strain.
Dephasing/scattering is represented by gamma or 1/tau and cannot by itself generate a nonzero conditioned residual.
dz2 spectral weight Z_dz2 is conditioned out, leaving only the bilayer phase-transfer geometry of the dz2/pz channel.

claims.statement: The phrase C_phi or phase-bus readiness does not appear to have a direct prior-art equivalent in the nickelate searches; the nearest prior art is c-axis phase coherence, interlayer Josephson/tunneling response, optical spectral weight, and bilayer odd/even channel physics.

landing_calculation.type: Landing B: half-finished formula plus next-step blueprint
landing_calculation.current_formula: C_phi_ind = P_oe - (a0 + a1*W_c + a2*f_D + a3*gamma + a4*V_O + a5*epsilon_strain + a6*Z_dz2), with P_oe = (chi_odd - chi_even)/(chi_odd + chi_even)
landing_calculation.why_not_full_numerical_prediction: Published Round 1 searches did not reveal a directly tabulated normal-state pressurized La3Ni2O7 dataset containing c-axis optical spectral weight, odd/even channel susceptibility, oxygen/strain controls, and dz2 spectral weight for identical samples.
blueprint: Extract W_c, W_D, and gamma from pressure-dependent c-axis infrared/THz or optical-conductivity data if available; otherwise define the needed experiment.
Extract V_O from STEM/EELS or oxygen-vacancy reported proxies and epsilon_strain from pressure/structural refinements.
Extract Z_dz2 from ARPES/XANES/RIXS orbital-sensitive data or DFT+DMFT-constrained fits.
Use Raman/RIXS/neutron/theory-constrained bilayer response to estimate chi_odd and chi_even in the normal state.
Fit B_base without superconducting output labels and test whether C_phi_ind differs from zero and changes rank.
landing_calculation.hard_boundary: No claim of predictor validation is made; this is only an input-side existence discriminator.

deepening.deepening_1_next_consequence: If residual P_oe exists, then phase-bus readiness is a geometry/channel-selective property of bilayer transfer, not a scalar conductivity strength. The next consequence is that pressure can improve C_phi by rotating spectral weight into the odd interlayer phase channel even when total W_c or Drude fraction does not improve.
deepening.deepening_1_second_consequence: The further consequence is an experimentally sharp rank inversion: a cleaner or more metallic sample can rank lower than a sample with less total c-axis weight if its odd/even bilayer transfer is phase-frustrated.
deepening.deepening_2_weak_premise: The weakest premise is that chi_odd and chi_even can be inferred before superconducting output without smuggling in gap, Meissner, or zero-resistance information.
deepening.deepening_2_second_consequence: If this premise fails, the independent C_phi proposal collapses operationally even if the microscopic concept is real, because no zero-leakage input-side observable remains.
